skills.description:
{Expert Necromancy}

Raises up to 30% of defeated living creatures as Skeleton Knights, limited by their health. With the Cloak of the Undead King: Lich Kings.

endingLayouts.scope: All28 Expert skills granted by unchanged final zc4 initializer; native storage and mobile visibility/scroll stability. No level-up cap change.

limitations: Declared native offline QA army input: five Black Dragons in free slots, three surviving to the prison quest; the native guard consumes one. No hero, quest artifact, script or quest-flag injection.
Native QA armies/resources/levels and instant/native unlimited movement accelerate progression; this is not economy or difficulty validation.
Final fourth-scenario victory is separate and remains required for activation.
